# Code quality audits

<!-- Generated by agent-audit -Init from .agent-audit/. Edit those files and rerun it. -->

The [agent-audit](https://github.com/straussna/agent-audit) plugin writes its audit reports here.
Its lens guide and glossary describe each lens, the metrics and the finding terms.

Run it from any directory:

```powershell
& "C:\source\repos\agentic-society\audit.ps1"                  # the default audits at HEAD
& "C:\source\repos\agentic-society\audit.ps1" -Audits <audit>  # one audit
& "C:\source\repos\agentic-society\audit.ps1" -Audits meta     # meta, after its siblings' findings are committed
```

`audit.ps1` runs the plugin checkout it names and passes every flag through to the plugin's driver.

| Audit | Lens | Score line | Lens defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patterns` | patterns | Patterns Score | plugin |
| `coupling` | coupling | Coupling Score | plugin |
| `simplicity` | simplicity | Simplicity Score | plugin |
| `typing` | typing | Typing Score | plugin |
| `testing` | testing | Testing Score | plugin |
| `guardrails` | guardrails, scoped to `harness.py`, `experiment.py`, `progress.py`, `providers`, `interaction`, `analyze.py`, `view.py`, `human.py`, `Dockerfile`, `config.toml` | Guardrails Score | plugin |
| `docs` | docs | Docs Score | plugin |
| `meta` | meta | Meta Score | plugin |

This repository's audit settings live in [`.agent-audit/`](../.agent-audit/):

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `config.json` | audits, paths and pack settings |
| `guidance/` | guidance added to a lens's brief: `coupling.md`, `docs.md`, `guardrails.md`, `patterns.md`, `simplicity.md`, `testing.md` |

Every audit runs under the privacy block in `config.json`. Audit agents are told not to read
its forbidden roots, and the provider must support the configured file and tool restrictions;
a shell command or script that reads a file without naming its path is not stopped.
The driver lints every digest, ledger and audit report,
and keeps none that names a forbidden root.

Audit reports, ledgers and precompute digests are untracked. `.scores.tsv` and each audit's
`.last-audited-commit` are tracked.
